src:
Create a strong but short lived protective shield around you for 3 turns which can absorb up to %d damage.
 		The total damage the barrier can absorb will increase with your Spellpower and the duration can Spell crit.

Fire a wave of repulsion in all directions out to a radius of %d.
		All creatures are struck for %0.2f physical damage and knocked away.
		All enemy projectiles are reflected back to their source.
		Damage scales with Spellpower.

Release arcane energies into most magical shields currently protecting you.
		It will affect at most %d shield effects.
		Damage Shield, Time Shield, Displacement Shield:  Increase the damage absorption value by %d%%.
		At raw talent level 5, it will also increase shield durations by 1 turn.
		Disruption Shield: Tap into the stored energies to restore the shield (at a rate of 2 energy per 1 shield power). Any leftover energy is converted back into mana at a rate of %0.2f energy per mana.
		The charging will increase with your Spellpower.

Conjure a molten boulder and roll it in the direction you choose, and enemies that don't get out of the way will take %0.2f fire damage, %0.2f physical damage and be knocked back.
		Burning Wake will leave a trail of flames behind the boulder.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

Create an eruption of steam in a radius 1 at the target location, doing %0.2f fire damage and %0.2f cold damage.
		The steam will also linger for 4 turns doing another %d damage per turn in a radius of %d.
		Creatures hit will be Wet for 3 turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

Conjures up mana into a powerful beam of plasma, doing %0.2f lightning damage and %0.2f fire damage.
		The beam also explodes in a radius of %d at the target doing the same damage again.
		Tempest will add a daze chance to this spell.
		Burning Wave will leave a trail of flames on the ground.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

Conjures an avalanche of snow, dealing %0.2f physical damage and %0.2f cold damage in a radius of %d. Any creatures caught inside will be be frozen to the ground for 4 turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

Thunder emanates from you in a circular wave with radius %d, doing %0.2f lightning damage, %0.2f physical damage and possibly stunning anyone affected (25%% chance).
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

Invokes a forking beam of liquid lightning doing %0.2f cold damage, %0.2f lightning damage and forking to another target.
		It can hit up to %d targets up to 10 grids apart, and will never hit the same one twice; nor will it hit the caster.
		Creatures hit will be Wet for 5 turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

You learn how to create small Draughts that give useful combat effects. 
		However, they are slightly toxic and have detrimental side effects (and a bad after taste).
		Quickness Draught: Increases your Movement Speed by %d%% and your Evasion chance by %d%%. But leaves you weakened when it wears off.
		Focus Draught: Increases your Critical Chances by %d%% and your Critical Power by %d%%. But leaves you slowed when it wears off.
		Toughness Draught: Increases your Armour by %d and your Armour Hardiness by %d%%. But leaves you confused when it wears off.
		Each Draught lasts for %d turns and the side effects last for %d turns.
		Using a Draught will put the other Draughts on cooldown as well.
		Draught strengths scale with your Cunning and Talent level.
		Durations scale with Talent level.

You learn how to create small Balms that give useful curative effects.
		Regenerative Balm: Lasts for %d turns. Each turn it heals you for %d life and reduces all bleeding effects by 1 turn.
		Antidote Balm: Reduces the duration of all Poison and Disease effects on you by %d turns.
		Clarity Balm: Cures up to %d detrimental mental effects from you.
		Using a Balm will put the other Balms on cooldown as well.
		Balm strengths and durations scale with your Cunning and Talent level.

Your Master level knowledge of Herbalism allows you to improve the other talents in the Herbalism category.
		Herb Lore: Now adds a bonus to your Healing Factor equal to %d%% of the Poison/Disease resistance bonus.
		Battle Draught: Reduces the duration of the detrimental side effects by %d%%.
		Curative Balm: Reduces the turn cost of using a Balm by %d%%.
		The cooldown timers of Draughts and Balms are also reduced by %d.
		These modifiers scale with your Cunning.

Prepare and ingest a home(/dungeon)-made concoction for a quick boost to your agility.
		Increases your movement speed by %d%% and your evasion chance by %d%% for %d turns.
		This effect will leave you weakened for %d turns after it expires.
		Using this will place all Draughts on cooldown.

Prepare and ingest a home(/dungeon)-made concoction for a quick boost to your focus.
		Increases your Critical Chances by %d%% and your Critical Power by %d%% for %d turns.
		This effect will leave you slowed for %d turns after it expires.
		Using this will place all Draughts on cooldown.

Prepare and ingest a home(/dungeon)-made concoction for a quick boost to your toughness.
		Increases your Armour by %d and your Armour Hardiness by %d%% for %d turns.
		This effect will leave you confused for %d turns after it expires.
		Using this will place all Draughts on cooldown.

Prepare and apply a home(/dungeon)-made concoction for a small regeneration effect.
		Each turn for %d turns, you will heal for %d life and each bleeding status on you will have its duration reduced by 1 extra turn.
		Using this will place all Balms on cooldown.

Prepare and apply a home(/dungeon)-made concoction for a quick antidote effect.
		Reduces the duration of all Poison and Disease effects on you by %d turns.
		Using this will place all Balms on cooldown.

Prepare and apply a home(/dungeon)-made concoction for some quick clarity.
		Cures up to %d detrimental mental effects from you.
		Using this will place all Balms on cooldown.

Fire a slowish bolt of a random element doing %0.2f damage.
		At level 5 it also does 50%% splash damage to adjacent targets.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

The Arcanist focusses on supreme control over mana, allowing them to adjust how it flows near them.
		Increases mana regen by +%0.1f, arcane resistance by %d%% and arcane resistance cap by %d%%.
Grants +%d%% silence resistance and +%d spell save.

Unleash power similar to the original Spellblaze, but on a much smaller scale.
		The primary explosion is a radius 2 burst that will release %d extra uncontrolled bolts. These will fly in a random direction and also explode.
		Each explosion will do %0.2f arcane damage and %0.2f fire damage, and will destroy walls.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
		Spellcraft will not protect you from this spell.

Disrupt the target's mind, doing %0.2f mind damage and brainlocking them for %d turns.
		The target may make a mind save against your spellpower to half the damage.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

Wrap the target's mind in a delusion, making them think you are their friend for %d turns.
		If you damage the target it will be free from the delusion.

src:
Cast a chaotic ray of light that bounces and hits up to %d enemies, up to 6 grids apart.
		They will be hurt for %0.2f light damage and be confused (%d power) for %d turns.
		The damage and confusion strength will increase with your Spellpower.

The caster is surrounded by a modified phantasmal shield. If hit by a projectile weapon or a spell, the shield will deal %d light damage to the attacker.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

Magically animate your melee weapon and have it fly at a nearby enemy, attacking them for %d%% weapon damage.
		This attack uses Spellpower in place of Accuracy and if it hits, will knock the target off balance for 4 turns.
		Weapon damage multiplier scales with Spellpower.
		(Will trigger when hit in melee effects on target.)
A weapon animated by arcane forces. It will fight to protect its animator.

Magically animate a weapon and command it to protect you. This enchantment will cause it to attack all nearby enemies for %d turns. When the spell ends, the weapon will drop to the ground. Attack Speed: %d%%

Summon a storm of swirling blades to slice your foes, inflicting %0.2f physical damage and bleeding to anyone who approaches, for %d turns.
		The damage and duration will increase with your Spellpower.

Allows you to animate a shield to guard you. (This allows you to equip a shield in the Psionic Focus slot. Use the Animate Shield ability to equip the shield.)
		The animated shield will also reduce all damage you take by %d.
		Damage reduction scales with Spellpower.
Encase a shield in magical animating forces, holding it aloft and setting it to guard you.

src: Increases mana regeneration by +%0.1f and maximum mana by +%d.

Removes all inscription saturations and reduces the cooldown of your inscriptions by %d turns.
		Doesn't work on Implants.

Charge an alchemist gem (or pebble) and throw it, it will explode with a radius of %d that illuminates the area.
		This light is strong enough to blind for %d turns. It also deals %0.2f arcane damage.
		If an alchemist gem is used, it increases the damage by 10%% per material level.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

Improves the contribution of primary stats on your inscriptions (any type) by %d%%.
		Inscription effects also last %d%% longer.

Cast a weapon enhancing enchantment on a weapon of your choice.
		This increases the accuracy of the weapon by +%d and reduces the physical stat requirements by %d.
		These values scale with your Spellpower.
		Enchantments make items arcane powered and you can only have one enchantment on an item at once.
		This talent also acts as a mastery talent for enchanted weapons.
		Increases Physical Power by %d and increases weapon damage by %d%% when using enchanted weapons.
		Will not stack with another Weapon Mastery talent.

Cast a heavy armour enhancing enchantment on an armour of your choice.
		This makes the armour easier to use, reducing the physical stat requirements by %d and the fatigue by %d.
		At level 1, it allows you to wear enchanted heavy mail armour, gauntlets, helms, and heavy boots.
		At level 2, it allows you to wear enchanted shields.
		At level 3, it allows you to wear enchanted massive plate armour.
		Enchantments make items arcane powered and you can only have one enchantment on an item at once.
		This talent also acts an armour mastery talent.
		You become better at using your enchanted armour to deflect blows and protect your vital areas. 
		Increases Armour value by %d, Armour hardiness by %d%%, and reduces chance to be critically hit by %d%% with your current body armour.
		(This talent only provides bonuses when wearing heavy mail or massive plate armour.)
		All effects of this talent only apply to armour that has been enchanted and do not stack with another armour training talent.
		These values scale with your Spellpower.

Charge raw arcane power into your weapon and then attack an adjacent enemy, doing %d%% weapon damage converted to arcane.
		If this hits, the target will be thrown back.
		This attack uses your spellpower in place of accuracy and applies all on weapon hit bonusses and effects at +%d%% strength.
		Damage multiplier increases with Spellpower.

When you throw your alchemist bombs, you infuse them with explosive metal shards that cause bleeding.
		In addition all physical damage you do is increased by %d%%.
		You cannot have more than one alchemist infusion sustain active at once.

While Metal Infusion is active, your bombs cover your golem in a shell of shrapnel for %d turns when they hit it.
		While covered in this shell, any damage done to your golem is reduced by %d and any melee attacker will take %0.1f physical damage.
		The effects increase with your talent level and with the Spellpower and damage modifiers of your golem.

Creates a line of dangerously sharp barbed wire of length %d for %d turns.
		Any creatures attempting to cross the line will be pinned for 1 turn and take %0.1f bleeding damage over 5 turns.
		Damage scales with your Spellpower.

Take refuge inside your golem for %d turns. When this effect ends, you will be healed for %d.
		This will also move any buffs/debuffs from you to your golem.
		Healing scales with your Spellpower.

Weakens your target, decreasing its defense, damage and saves by %d for 10 turns.
		The weakening will improve with your spellpower.

src:
Focus your magic inwards enhancing your physical form. 
		This increases your Strength, Dexterity and Constitution by %d.
		You also physically recover faster, increasing your Life regeneration by %0.1f and your Stamina regeneration by %0.1f per turn.
		These values will increase with your Spellpower.

Attempt to turn all creatures in a radius %d around a point to stone for %d turns.
		Stoned creatures are unable to act or regen life and are very brittle.
		If a stoned creature is hit by an attack that deals more than 30%% of its life it will shatter and be destroyed.
		Stoned creatures are highly resistant to fire and lightning and somewhat resistant to physical attacks.

All nearby enemies within radius %d are violently deconstructed, disarming them and doing %0.2f arcane damage.
		Does +50%% damage verses stoned targets.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

Increases weapon damage by %d%% and physical power by 30 when using staves.
		Also grants the Channel Staff ability, which lets you fire an energy bolt from an equipped staff.

Strike the ground with your staff, creating a shockwave that travels up to %d tiles.
		Any enemy the shockwave passes through will take %d%% melee damage as physical, and be stunned for %d turns.
		Stun chance will improve with Spellpower.
Adopt a defensive posture, increasing your Defense, Armour and Spell Save by %d.

Spin around, extending your weapon and damaging all targets around you for %d%% weapon damage. 
		Raw power flows through your staff, projecting a nova of your staff's element doing %d%% weapon damage as its current element.
		Different staff elements result in different effects.
		Fire: Flameshock.
		Cold: Frozen Ground.
		Acid: Disarming Acid.
		Lightning: Lightning Daze.
		Light: Blinding Light.
		Darkness: Darkness Knockback.
		Nature: Natural Slow.
		Blight: Blighted Disease.
		Physical: Physical Bleeding.
		Temporal: Temporal Stat Reduction.
		Arcane: Arcane Silence.
		Mental: Brainlocking Mind.

src:
Learn how to cast lesser runes. You will learn new runes as follows:
		Level 1: Lesser Magic Missile
		Level 2: Lesser Lightning
		Level 3: Lesser Heat Beam
		Level 4: Lesser Acid Wave
		Level 5: Lesser Biting Gale
		These lesser runes work like runes for the purposes of Runic Saturation, Quicken Inscriptions, Inscription Mastery, but do not take up an inscription slot.

With perfect control, you teleport to another location up to %d tiles away. 
		Additional talent points increase the range.

Immobilise (pin and stun) all creatures in a radius %d ball for %d turns.

Cover yourself in bright arcane fire. The flames will not hurt you, but will hurt anyone who hits you in melee for %d fire and %d arcane damage.

While Poison Infusion is active, your bombs coat your golem in poison for %d turns when they hit it.
		While coated, any attack made by your golem has a %d%% chance to trigger a beam of poison towards the target, that does %0.1f nature damage over 6 turns. (This can only happen once per turn.)
		The effects increase with your talent level and with the Spellpower and damage modifiers of your golem.

Hurl a flask of knockout gas, which explodes on impact releasing the gas in a radius of %d.
		Any creatures affected by the gas will be put to sleep (%d power) for %d turns.
		Alchemist Protection reduction works as a chance to avoid hitting yourself with this.
		Sleep power scales with your Spellpower.

Carefully administered potions and magic allow you to transform your body into a much stronger form.
		This increases your physical power and physical saves by %d, your maximum life by %d, your life regeneration by %d per turn, and your size category by 1.
		Each hit (spell or weapon) you make also has a %d%% chance of firing a beam of poison at the target, doing %0.1f nature damage over 6 turns.

Cast a beam of poison at your target, doing %0.2f poison damage over six turns.

The Void is not empty. There is power there, and madness. It wants you.

A new Element, one of great power.

Conveyance and Temporal magic combine in this school. Master them and distort space and time to your needs.
An extension of the Phantasm school, Illusion lets you take the fight directly into the minds of your enemies.
Magical energies and forces are carefully balanced everywhere. Tip the balance if you wish.
Shape life with arcane forces. Created by mages working in secret to repair the damage of the Spellblaze.
Hedgemagery that focusses on control at the expense power.
Hedgemagery that focusses on power at the expense of control. Use at your own risk.
The forging of different elements into powerful spells.

The infusion of raw aether into base elemental magic.

src: Arcanists are Archmages who focus on control of pure magical power and the Cosmos in general, rather than playing with dirty elements directly.
Archmagi start with knowledge of many schools of magic. They sometimes dabble with dark magics, for purely academic reasons.
Most Arcanists have been trained in the secret town of Angolwen and possess a unique spell to teleport to it directly.
Elementists are a bit more down to earth than most Archmages.
While Archmages focus on control of pure magical power and the Cosmos in general, Elements focus on controlling the physical elements around them.
Archmagi start with knowledge of many schools of magic. However, they usually refuse to have anything to do with dark magics.
Most Elementists have been trained in the secret town of Angolwen and possess a unique spell to teleport to it directly.

An Enchanter is a manipulator of materials using magic.
Their lack of advanced magical training from Angolwen, means that their spells don't have the power or finesse of an Archmage.
On the other hand, they have carefully studied every magical item they could get their hands on, and can enchant their own items (and themselves).
Someone deciding to take on an Enchanter could find themselves up against surprisingly effective hedgemagic, a whole enchanted armoury, or both.

Beginner classes cost 100 gold.
Advanced classes cost 500 gold.
Mastery classes cost 1000 gold.
Some subjects (categories) are tougher than others and you may need to improve your Magic before you are able to study them.

At what level would you like to study?

Our goal in Angolwen is to see magic preserved for future use by all. 
We would like to teach as much as anyone wants to learn, but we would also see that magic favours no people in particular. 
We have only so much time we can devote to teaching, so we restrict it to a little per person.
This way, anybody who genuinely wishes to study magic will not be turned away.
And so, we cannot accept payment for more training.
Tolerance of the arcane is all that we request as payment.
